title: Midnight Mirage — original 1980s/1990s movie television spots
notes: Curated cult, surreal, fantasy and strange-cinema theatrical-film TV advertisements, 15–35 seconds. Whole individually archived television spots, never modern full-length theatrical trailers. Play only between films. Historical source attribution is not a rights-clearance claim. No generic product advertisements.

source.yearEvidence: Archive source title/description and historical date identify the original 1981 film television spot; original broadcast day is not documented.

validation.boundaries: Entire individually archived television spot retained; no cuts inside the advertisement.
validation.visualReview: Full-spot 1fps contact sheet reviewed: coherent single advertisement, opening and closing title/billing cards retained; no neighboring program footage.
